label: Complete-decision fork, by Mathlib order theory (inference)
rule: maximal_iff_forall_gt on insert o C; Set.Finite.exists_le_maximal for uniqueness; a finite set-inclusion control
meaning: Omission's maximality fails exactly at a strictly better creation. A creation's maximality in insert o C splits into maximality in C and not lying below o. In a finite C every creation lies below a maximal one, which uniqueness makes m. An improvable C with a creation above o leaves no maximal decision. The policy clause is clause 1 at each world. The control evaluates singletons of Bool.
